verdict.rationale: Workstation compliance monitoring is a fair axis for a compliance automation platform, but the evidence pack never describes a Sprinto endpoint agent or per-employee device checks for disk encryption, screen lock, or password manager. The only nearby item is a bare 'JumpCloud Integration' doc title. Its content isn't shown, so there is no evidence it pulls device-posture data rather than identity or access data. Generic 'continuous monitoring' claims do not establish this capability.
